project_name: RitualOS / Pulse - Expo Go Web Adaptation
concept: A high-performance daily ritual and focus flow manager adapted from a mobile Expo Go app into a fluid, responsive desktop & mobile web experience. Bridges native touch patterns (bottom navigation, swipe gestures, quick status toggles, mobile simulator mode) with rich desktop capabilities (multi-column bento analytics, drag-and-drop ritual creation, ambient audio soundscapes, streak tracking, and FastAPI persistence).

identity_and_theme.archetype: Organic Performance Pro (Tactical Minimalism & Swiss Precision)
identity_and_theme.tone: Focused, tactile, serene, highly productive, premium
identity_and_theme.theme_support: Light and Dark mode toggle with persistent local storage / system preference
identity_and_theme.mobile_web_bridge_feature: Interactive Expo Simulator Toggle - allows users to preview the exact mobile layout side-by-side with full desktop layout

scale.hero_title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.caption: text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase text-muted-foreground

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 sm:gap-6 lg:gap-8
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-aligned content flow with optical padding; clear grid borders and glassmorphism subtle headers.

key_functionalities.1_responsive_adaptation: Fluid conversion between Mobile Expo view (bottom tab navigation, compact cards, swipe actions) and Desktop Web view (sidebar navigation, wide bento analytics, multi-column dashboard).
key_functionalities.2_demo_data_and_backend: FastAPI endpoints delivering initial demonstration rituals, habits, categories, completion history, and focus timer logs with full REST API supporting GET, POST, PUT, DELETE.
key_functionalities.3_creation_flow: Interactive Quick Create modal & full detail creation flow for new daily rituals (Title, Category, Target Duration, Frequency, Priority, Emoji/Icon, Energy Tag).
key_functionalities.4_persistence_and_refresh: Real-time state refresh via TanStack React Query / local reactive state with automated refetching, instant optimist UI toggles, and toast notifications (Sonner).
key_functionalities.5_expo_simulator_mode: Dedicated toggle button allowing users to view the web app wrapped in an interactive iPhone/Expo Go frame preview to directly contrast Mobile vs Desktop layout UX.
key_functionalities.6_focus_soundscapes_timer: Built-in pomodoro/focus timer with ambient soundscape toggles (Lo-Fi Cafe, Deep Rain, White Noise, Forest Drift) for deep work sessions.

component_hierarchy: Navbar (Logo, Navigation Tabs, Expo Mobile Simulator Toggle, Theme Switcher, Create Ritual CTA)
ExpoMobileBanner (Context banner highlighting Mobile App to Responsive Web transformation status)
BentoHeaderSummary (Daily Completion %, Active Streaks, Total Focus Minutes, Mood/Energy Index)
MainGridContainer (Bento layout split between Rituals List/Board and Focus/Analytics widgets)
RitualFilters (Category tabs: All, Morning, Deep Work, Health, Craft; Status filter; Search input)
RitualCard (Card item with completion checkbox, category badge, streak count, quick edit, sub-tasks)
CreateRitualDialog (Shadcn Dialog form with inputs for title, category, target time, frequency, energy level)
FocusTimerWidget (Interactive timer countdown with audio soundscape player)
AnalyticsWidget (Recharts visual bar/area charts showing weekly ritual consistency)
ExpoMobileSimulatorModal (Modal/Drawer rendering mobile viewport emulator of the Expo Go interface)

testing_attributes.convention: kebab-case data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, cards, and modal triggers

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure backend FastAPI (server.py & routers) exposes full endpoints for /api/rituals (GET, POST, PUT /:id/toggle, DELETE) with rich seed demo data in Portuguese & English.
2. Customize UI using Tailwind CSS variables and Lucide icons without relying on plain default Vercel styles.
3. Implement micro-interactions using framer-motion/motion for card completions, modal entries, and tab transitions.
4. Ensure proper contrast compliance (APCA / WCAG AA) for dark and light modes.
5. Make sure every interactive button and container has data-testid attached.
6. Include the Expo Mobile View Simulator toggle so the user can see how their Expo Go mobile layout translates directly to a responsive web SaaS.
